title: EZ Emerald Pouch
description: Stores emeralds infinitely. Keeps it simple, works alongside any mod(pack).
body:
The mod is simple, so I'll keep it short.

If you've tried currency mods before (Lightman's, Numismatic, etc), you'll usually run into the same problem: they don't work with all of your mods. Or they add a lot of extra systems, blocks, GUIs, and mechanics you don't actually want.

Hence, EZ Emerald Pouch.

No currencies.
No economy overhaul.
Just emeralds, done cleanly.

How it works:

  1. Craft an Emerald Pouch

2. Store emeralds into your pouch:

  • Picking up emeralds automatically stores them
  • SHIFT + Right Click an Emerald or Emerald Block in your inventory to deposit it

The pouch stores an infinite amount of emeralds. Game logic, who cares. 🤷‍♀️

3. While trading (or whenever your inventory is open), click the Withdraw button to take out emeralds.
SHIFT + Click withdraws multiple stacks.

4. Press O to edit the GUI elements:

  • Move the emerald counter
  • Move the withdraw button
  • Resize elements
  • Hide or show elements
  • Reset everything to defaults

All settings are client-side only.

Extra notes:

  • Fully server-authoritative (no client-side emerald cheating)
  • Optional Curios support (custom pouch slot)
  • Designed to work alongside any mod that uses emeralds

That's it.
EZ Emerald Pouch does one thing — and stays out of your way.

Assets are made & owned by Glionox.
